name: Predicted-Skip

main_jobs.why: native unmodified GDN-2, essential direct comparator
closest skip mechanism with value write suppression but no erase scaling
GDN-2-port of joint erase/write answer feedback, with native guard parity

short_ablation_jobs.why: does previous-query information matter beyond extra parameters?
replace previous-query read by current-key feedback

evaluations: PRIMARY: old knowledge retention AND new fact plasticity after answer re-entry, 2,000 held-out cases each for overwrite/alias/hot-cold/changed answer; false skip rate and event-conditioned suppression
Native FineWeb-Edu NLL >=20M tokens, WikiText-103, LAMBADA, commonsense QA and retrieval tasks with fixed native prompt/eval
Native RULER 500 samples per supported task/length 4K-32K plus 2,000 independent priority NIAH/multi-key cases
Official NVIDIA GDN-2 forward/backward/guard parity and end-to-end GPU token throughput, prefill/decode latency, allocations, extra kernel work
reference_notes: Vuk Rosic's original Predicted-Skip already includes write and joint erase/write suppression (lpsE=1). The joint mechanism itself is PRIOR ART. A GDN-2 port alone is not established paper-level originality.
QED native official release or faithful independent reimplementation must be confirmed. Do not conflate mismatched update rules.
Soft skip is not actual reduced FLOPs unless a concrete kernel avoids work.
Initial official kernel parity validation must pass before a full run.
